quests.instruction: Read the sentence aloud as a closing promise to yourself.
quests.hint: 'whatever' stresses EV, 'challenges' ends in [ɪz], 'confident' stresses CON, 'listen' has a silent t, and 'practising' stresses PRAC.
quests.explanation: A confident closing: three parallel actions, each with a peak (LISTen, SPEAK, PRACtise), and a final fall on 'day'. 'every' has two beats.
quests.textToSpeak: Whatever challenges come next, I'm confident I can handle them: I'll listen carefully, speak clearly, and keep practising every single day.
quests.phoneticHint: [wɒtˈevər ˈtʃælɪndʒɪz ˈkʌm ˈnekst] | [aɪm ˈkɒnfɪdənt aɪ kən ˈhændəl ðəm] | [aɪl ˈlɪsən ˈkeərfəli] | [ˈspiːk ˈklɪrli] | [ənd ˈkiːp ˈpræktɪsɪŋ ˈevri ˈsɪŋgəl ˈdeɪ].
